offering_description.value: Distributes propane, fuel oil and refined fuels, natural gas and electricity to residential, commercial, industrial and agricultural customers. Also installs and services heating and cooling equipment. Delivers from storage terminals and branch locations via its own truck fleet.

primary_products.value: propane; fuel oil and refined fuels; natural gas; electricity; propane tanks and heating equipment

primary_services.value: propane and fuel delivery; HVAC installation and repair; equipment maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential households for home heating, cooking and hot water; B2B: commercial, industrial and agricultural customers

end_markets.value: residential heating; commercial and industrial energy; agriculture; HVAC services

revenue_model.value: product sales: propane, fuel oil, natural gas and electricity sold by volume; service fees: HVAC installation, repair and maintenance

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys propane and fuels from producers and suppliers, sells to end users; service provider: installs and services heating and cooling equipment; asset operator: operates storage terminals, delivery trucks and branch locations

geography_served.value: US national: Operations in about 40 states, concentrated in the Northeast, Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, West and Southeast

specialization.value: related lines: propane, fuel oil, natural gas and electricity, HVAC services, renewable natural gas

distribution_channels.value: own locations: retail branches and satellite locations with company delivery trucks; direct sales: direct delivery and tank-fill to customers, tank exchange; online: customer portal ordering and account management

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Propane storage and transport under DOT, EPA, OSHA, NFPA codes and state utility rules for natural gas and electricity
